projects.name: OpenAI/Oracle Stargate Lighthouse Campus, Port Washington
projects.description: 672-acre Stargate campus. Second building topped out June 2026. 902MW, 2.5M SF across four buildings; ~5,000 peak construction workers. Live 2028.
projects.open_for: Active Stargate build. Hyperscale MEP specs.

projects.name: Microsoft Fairwater Campus, Mount Pleasant
projects.description: First Fairwater data center operational June 2026; second building under construction for 2028. Approval for 15 additional buildings January 2026.
projects.open_for: Multi-building expansion. Ongoing MEP specs.

projects.name: Aspirus Wausau Hospital Expansion
projects.description: $227M hospital expansion groundbreaking held May 8, 2026. Multi-phase project running through 2028 adds 48 intermediate care beds, 16 observation beds, fixed PET/CT scanner, and expanded surgical suites.

sources.title: Aspirus breaks ground on $227 million Wausau hospital expansion - Innovatrix

projects.open_for: Under construction. Structural work, medical MEP, specialized imaging suites.

projects.name: Amazon Delivery Facility, DeForest
projects.description: 218,000 SF Amazon parcel delivery facility in DeForest. Construction starting July 2026 by Ryan Companies with completion set for June 2027. Features 15 semi-truck loading docks and 914 van stalls.

sources.title: Amazon delivery facility coming to DeForest - HNG News

projects.open_for: Under construction. Site work, building shell, dock doors, MEP.

projects.name: Rockwell Automation Advanced Manufacturing Campus
projects.description: Phase 1 calls for an 810,000 SF advanced manufacturing facility (770k SF manufacturing + 40k SF office) in New Berlin on West Grange Ave, expandable to over 1M SF. City approvals reviewed July 2026, groundbreaking planned late 2026.

sources.title: New Berlin Plan Commission reviews Rockwell Automation - GMToday

projects.open_for: Planning & rezoning. Advance procurement for industrial shell and MEP.
